task.notes: t = 1/3 between the brackets (test: E7.75 at t = 1/2 between E7.5 and E8.0).

floor.what: the organisers' floor: the reference's 10% working copy (copy_last or wt_identity)

fgw.what: displacement interpolation between the brackets (fused Gromov-Wasserstein coupling, proper rotation, McCann moves) with a mixture of real cells of both, scaled to the embryo size rule

fgw_shape0.what: fgw's mixture of real cells in the earlier bracket's geometry (t_pos = 0), scaled to the embryo size rule

fgw_shape0_series.what: fgw_shape0 (the earlier bracket's geometry) with the series rendering
fgw_shape0_series.rule: series: the shallower bracket's drawn cells are moved by a per-gene factor and then to the deeper bracket's depth (RENDER_RULE, hi). The factor is the T3 script's gene_factor over the cell-type labels that both brackets hold by name with at least SERIES_MIN_CELLS cells each and that are extraembryonic (a name starting with EXE-, or the lineage group ExtraEmbryonicMeso): the ratio of the two brackets' share-weighted mean within-cell panel proportions, weights the shallower bracket's label shares, eps 1e-5, rescaled so the weighted total proportion is unchanged, clipped to 0.25-4. It is applied in count space (binomial thinning below 1, Poisson top-up from the cell's kNN-smoothed proportions above 1). The deeper bracket's cells stay as released

fgw_aligned_series.what: fgw_series (the series rendering) with the moves taken from the aligned coupling of try E10 (vec.core.aligned_coupling in the rotated common frame; FGW's rotation kept)
